question: Where is gallery located inside a 180 kilometers radius on the way from Gary Lapelusa Landscaping LLC, Bayonne, NJ to Stanford in New York Center, New York, NY?
sql: SELECT poi_name, addr_state, addr_city FROM pois WHERE tourism = 'gallery' AND ST_Intersects( pois.geometry::geography, ST_Buffer( ST_MakeLine( ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Gary Lapelusa Landscaping LLC%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Bayonne%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%NJ%' LIMIT 1 ), ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Stanford in New York Center%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%New York%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%NY%' LIMIT 1 ) )::geography, 180 * 1000 )::geography );
